name: Legacy grid-lines FAQ
purpose: Answer the objections a visitor still has at the bottom of a content or integrations page, in an accordion framed by legacy theme grid lines.
description: Relume-style 'grid lines' FAQ in container-large: a centred header cell (42rem wide, bordered left/right) with a pill eyebrow and a 3rem (2rem <=767) H2, then a single-column 42rem accordion of bordered rows (bold 1.25rem question cell + a separate square plus-icon cell), then a bottom spacer cell with a centre line (12rem; omitted for the green theme). The `theme` prop picks the line/open colours: 'olive' (/content/topics, /content/sector-suites), 'olive-items' (/content: item lines also olive) and 'green' (/lms/integrations: no top border, no bottom spacer). Outer side borders drop at <=991; one item can be open on load.

theme.note: Legacy colour theme: olive (/content/topics, /content/sector-suites), olive-items (/content), green (/lms/integrations).

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Click a row: the answer height animates 0 -> measured px in 400ms ease then snaps to auto; the plus icon rotates 0 -> 45deg in 200ms ease; row background and border colours switch in 100ms linear. Second click closes everything in 100ms linear. Items are independent.

evidenceNotes: Content-family answers are computed with prose(150 + ((i*47) % 160), seed + i*23) in src/pages/content/faqData.js; sample answers are the exact evaluated strings (TOPICS_FAQ seed 5, CONTENT_FAQ seed 0). /content/sector-suites uses SUITES_FAQ (seed 9) with the same olive theme.
/content/* pass eyebrow "FAQ's" and title 'Every answer, right here'; /lms/integrations keeps the component default eyebrow 'FAQs' and passes title 'Integration FAQs'.
The component default items (5 library questions, title "Every answer in one place") are not rendered by any route.
xsCompact and answerClassName are layout knobs (not modelled); all three routes pass xsCompact.
On /lms/integrations six answers share one string; only the 4th item (API) has its own answer and is open on load.
